The bidder must submit a 5-year warranty certificate for LED streetlights. 6. The manufacturer should have dedicated local service centers to provide quick responses against the w arranty. 7. Both the manufacturer and the offered product must be registered in the UP PWD CAT AAA Sor; submit documentary evidence. .
